<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y8p-GQ6z6ft1YbIDzbrh"> <mxGraphModel dx="3096" dy="2176" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 class PaymentController {
 +pay(PaymentRequest) PaymentResponse
 +refund(RefundRequest) RefundResponse
 +verify(PaymentVerifyRequest) PaymentResponse
 }
 class RazorpayWebhookController {
 +verifyPayment(payload, signature) void
 }
 class PaymentOrchestrator {
 -PaymentRepository paymentRepository
 -PaymentServiceFactory paymentServiceFactory
 -PaymentResponseFactory paymentResponseFactory
 -InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository
 -InventoryService inventoryService
 -PaymentMapper paymentMapper
 -InvoiceValidation invoiceValidation
 +processInvoicePayment(PaymentRequest) PaymentResponse
 +processInvoiceRefund(RefundRequest) RefundResponse
 +verifyPayment(PaymentVerifyRequest) PaymentResponse
 +verifyWebhook(paymentId, orderId) void
 }
 class PaymentServiceFactory {
 -Map~String,PaymentService~ paymentServiceMap
 +getPaymentService(String method) PaymentService
 }
 class PaymentService {
 <<interface>>
 +pay(Payment) Payment
 +refund(Payment) Payment
 +verifyPayment(Payment, PaymentVerifyRequest) Payment
 +getPaymentMethod() String
 }
 class CashService {
 +getPaymentMethod() \"CASH\"
 }
 class RazorpayService {
 -RazorpayGateway gateway
 -RazorpayProperties razorpayProperties
 +getPaymentMethod() \"ONLINE\"
 }
 class RazorpayGateway {
 -RazorpayClient razorpayClient
 +createOrder(Payment) String
 +verifySignature(paymentId, orderId, signature) boolean
 +refundPayment(Payment) String
 }
 class WebhookService {
 -PaymentOrchestrator orchestrator
 -RazorpayProperties properties
 }
 class PaymentQueryService {
 -PaymentRepository paymentRepository
 +isAlreadySuccessful(gatewayOrderId) boolean
 }
 class PaymentMapper {
 +toPendingPayment(Invoice, PaymentRequest) Payment
 }
 class PaymentResponseFactory {
 +createResponse(Payment) PaymentResponse
 }
 class InvoiceValidation {
 +validateCanPay(Invoice)
 +validateCanRefund(Invoice)
 +validateCanCompletePayment(Invoice)
 }
 class Payment {
 +String paymentId
 +Invoice invoice
 +PaymentMethod paymentMethod
 +String gatewayOrderId
 +String gatewayPaymentId
 +String gatewayRefundId
 +PaymentStatus paymentStatus
 +long version
 +markSuccess()
 +markRefunded()
 +markExpired()
 }
 class PaymentMethod {
 <<enumeration>>
 CASH
 ONLINE
 }
 class PaymentStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 PENDING
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
 EXPIRED
 REFUNDED
 }

 PaymentController --> PaymentOrchestrator
 RazorpayWebhookController --> WebhookService
 WebhookService --> PaymentOrchestrator
 PaymentOrchestrator --> PaymentServiceFactory
 PaymentOrchestrator --> PaymentResponseFactory
 PaymentOrchestrator --> PaymentMapper
 PaymentOrchestrator --> InvoiceValidation
 PaymentServiceFactory --> PaymentService : keyed by getPaymentMethod()
 PaymentService <|.. CashService
 PaymentService <|.. RazorpayService
 RazorpayService --> RazorpayGateway
 PaymentMapper --> Payment : creates
 Payment --> PaymentMethod
 Payment --> PaymentStatus",
 "config": null
